body: Atlas review before combined commit. Blockers: A atlas.scala:175-180 ReaderAt must use the same transitive evidence closure as Codex, then horizon-restricted support; minSpan.end alone leaks/diverges. B lines 31-47 stuff horizontal SourceExtent into area: Option[MeasureMeaning]; set area=None unless actual 2-D area encodes a measure. C lines 363-371 validate only source, so a wrong build/config over the same source passes; validate model receipt/basis and Atlas state/spec config. Majors: D line 105 Boolean isState should be LandmarkKind.Event|State. E portals lines 280-293 ignore active RelationLayer.Reference. F ThreadPolicy.All(Int) and Extent raw bounds permit invalid public artifacts; use checked limit/extent and half-open x1Exclusive consistent with TextSpan. G ADR specifies typed ChannelMeaning/VisualInvariant but contract has Vector[String]; either implement typed cases now or explicitly narrow checkpoint contract. H textual twin should expose source/model/config/compiler receipt fields. Please give dispositions or patch your reserved files; I will hold the combined commit and not touch atlas.scala.
